import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1 << 29;
    static final int MAXN = 500;
    static class Edge {
        int a, b, cap, flow;
        Edge(int a, int b, int cap, int flow) {
            this.a = a;
            this.b = b;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static boolean[][] m = new boolean[11][11];
    static List<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[MAXN];
    static List<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] d = new int[MAXN], ptr = new int[MAXN];
    static int n, xb, yb, t;
    static int[][] temp = new int[11][11], kaps = new int[11][11];

    static int way(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
        Queue<int[]> l = new LinkedList<>();
        l.offer(new int[]{0, x1, y1});
        int[][] h = new int[11][11];
        for (int p = 0; p < n; p++)
            Arrays.fill(h[p], INF);
        while (!l.isEmpty()) {
            int[] v = l.poll();
            int vDist = v[0], x = v[1], y = v[2];
            h[x][y] = vDist;
            if (x > 0 && m[x - 1][y] && h[x - 1][y] > h[x][y] + 1 && ((x - 1 == x2 && y == y2 && temp[x - 1][y] >= h[x][y] + 1) || !(x - 1 == x2 && y == y2) && temp[x - 1][y] > h[x][y] + 1))
                l.offer(new int[]{vDist + 1, x - 1, y});
            if (y > 0 && m[x][y - 1] && h[x][y - 1] > h[x][y] + 1 && ((x == x2 && y - 1 == y2 && temp[x][y - 1] >= h[x][y] + 1) || !(x == x2 && y - 1 == y2) && temp[x][y - 1] > h[x][y] + 1))
                l.offer(new int[]{vDist + 1, x, y - 1});
            if (x < n - 1 && m[x + 1][y] && h[x + 1][y] > h[x][y] + 1 && ((x + 1 == x2 && y == y2 && temp[x + 1][y] >= h[x][y] + 1) || !(x + 1 == x2 && y == y2) && temp[x + 1][y] > h[x][y] + 1))
                l.offer(new int[]{vDist + 1, x + 1, y});
            if (y < n - 1 && m[x][y + 1] && h[x][y + 1] > h[x][y] + 1 && ((x == x2 && y + 1 == y2 && temp[x][y + 1] >= h[x][y] + 1) || !(x == x2 && y + 1 == y2) && temp[x][y + 1] > h[x][y] + 1))
                l.offer(new int[]{vDist + 1, x, y + 1});
        }
        return h[x2][y2];
    }

    static void addEdge(int a, int b, int cap) {
        Edge e1 = new Edge(a, b, cap, 0);
        Edge e2 = new Edge(b, a, 0, 0);
        g[a].add(e.size());
        e.add(e1);
        g[b].add(e.size());
        e.add(e2);
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(0);
        Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        d[0] = 0;
        int size = n * n * 2 + 2;
        while (!q.isEmpty() && d[size - 1] == -1) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int id : g[v]) {
                int to = e.get(id).b;
                if (d[to] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).cap) {
                    q.offer(to);
                    d[to] = d[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return d[size - 1] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        int size = n * n * 2 + 2;
        if (v == size - 1) return flow;
        for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ptr[v]++) {
            int id = g[v].get(ptr[v]);
            int to = e.get(id).b;
            if (d[to] != d[v] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs(to, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).cap - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            if (!bfs()) break;
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(0, INF)) > 0) {
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        String line;
        int k = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char x = line.charAt(j);
                temp[i][j] = t;
                if (x == 'Z') {
                    xb = i;
                    yb = j;
                    m[i][j] = false;
                } else if (x == 'Y') {
                    m[i][j] = false;
                } else {
                    m[i][j] = true;
                }
                addEdge(0, k++, (x == 'Z' || x == 'Y') ? 0 : x - '0');
            }
        }

        int baseK = n * n + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int k1 = n * n;
                k1++;
                for (int z = 0; z < n; z++) {
                    for (int w = 0; w < n; w++) {
                        k1++;
                        if (m[i][j] && m[z][w] && way(i, j, z, w) <= t) {
                            addEdge(k, k1, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS to update temp
        Queue<int[]> l = new LinkedList<>();
        l.offer(new int[]{0, xb, yb});
        while (!l.isEmpty()) {
            int[] v = l.poll();
            int vVal = v[0], x = v[1], y = v[2];
            temp[x][y] = vVal;
            if (x > 0 && vVal + 1 < temp[x - 1][y] && m[x - 1][y]) l.offer(new int[]{vVal + 1, x - 1, y});
            if (y > 0 && vVal + 1 < temp[x][y - 1] && m[x][y - 1]) l.offer(new int[]{vVal + 1, x, y - 1});
            if (x < n - 1 && vVal + 1 < temp[x + 1][y] && m[x + 1][y]) l.offer(new int[]{vVal + 1, x + 1, y});
            if (y < n - 1 && vVal + 1 < temp[x][y + 1] && m[x][y + 1]) l.offer(new int[]{vVal + 1, x, y + 1});
        }

        System.out.println(maxFlow());
    }
}
